name: bug
description: Trazum did something wrong, or did not do something it says it does

name: correctness
description: A rule moved what a prompt asks for, or a figure is not reproducible from the log

name: enhancement
description: Something Trazum should do that it does not do today

name: pricing
description: A price is wrong or dated, or a model is missing from the catalogue

name: documentation
description: A page is wrong, missing, or cannot be followed

name: dependencies
description: A dependency update, usually opened by Dependabot

name: needs-triage
description: New: nobody has decided what to do with it yet

name: needs-info
description: Waiting on the reporter for a reproduction or a source

name: accepted
description: Triaged: it will be done, by whoever picks it up

name: wontfix
description: Triaged: it will not be done; the closing comment says why

name: duplicate
description: Already reported; the closing comment links the original

name: good first issue
description: Accepted, small and fully specified: a good first contribution

name: help wanted
description: Accepted, and a pull request from anyone is welcome
